id.description: Globally unique identifier for this geographic area.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this GeographicArea.

entityType.description: IFS entity category/type for this geographic area.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this geographic area record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this geographic area record was last updated.

items.description: A polygon ring represented by coordinate positions; the first ring is the exterior boundary and subsequent rings, if any, are holes.

polygons.description: Polygon geometries making up this area. Separate polygons can represent disconnected regions. Coordinates use [longitude, latitude, optional altitude] positions.
